title: Significant figures and multi-step problems - 123 school
heading: Significant figures and multi-step problems
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
All the data you need is in the question. Every question tells you how to round. For a multi-step problem, the tip tells you how many steps you need.

questions.q: How many significant figures does 0.0480 have?
How many significant figures does 0.0070 have?
How many significant figures does 0.300 have?
How many significant figures does 6.0 have?
Round 1.0449 to 3 significant figures.
Round 29.995 to 4 significant figures.
Calculate 12.5 + 3.25. Give the answer to the correct number of decimal places.
questions.e: 12.5 + 3.25 = 15.75; the numbers have 1 and 2 decimal places, so rounding to 1 decimal place gives 15.8

questions.q: Calculate 0.056 + 1.2. Give the answer to the correct number of decimal places.
questions.e: 0.056 + 1.2 = 1.256; the numbers have 3 and 1 decimal places, so rounding to 1 decimal place gives 1.3

questions.q: Calculate 45.67 − 0.2. Give the answer to the correct number of decimal places.
questions.e: 45.67 − 0.2 = 45.47; the numbers have 2 and 1 decimal places, so rounding to 1 decimal place gives 45.5

questions.q: Calculate 7.0 + 0.25. Give the answer to the correct number of decimal places.
questions.e: 7.0 + 0.25 = 7.25; the numbers have 1 and 2 decimal places, so rounding to 1 decimal place gives 7.3

questions.q: Which rule applies when multiplying and dividing?
questions.a: The answer has as many significant figures as the number with the fewest significant figures.

questions.q: What must you do before you add 2.5 g and 125 mg?
questions.a: First put both in the same unit

questions.q: Rearrange the formula n = m / M so that M is on the left.
Rearrange the formula c = n / V so that n is on the left.
How many K is 25 °C?
Solve: x / 18.0 = 2.50. What is x?

A solution has a concentration of 0.80 g/L. How many grams of dissolved substance are there in 250 mL of this solution? Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
A liquid has a density of 0.92 g/mL. What is the volume in L of 150 g of this liquid? Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You have 25.0 mL of ethanol with a density of 0.79 g/mL. The molar mass is 46.0 g/mol. How many moles of ethanol is that? Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You have 250 mL of solution with a concentration of 0.200 mol/L. How many moles of dissolved substance does it contain? Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
A 75 W lamp burns for 4.0 hours. How many kWh of energy does the lamp use? (1 kW = 1000 W) Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You mix 125 mL of water (1.00 g/mL) with 45.0 mL of ethanol (0.790 g/mL). What is the total mass of the mixture in grams? Round to 3 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 1.00 g/mL × 125 mL = 125 g of water and 0.790 g/mL × 45.0 mL = 35.55 g of ethanol. Step 2: 125 g + 35.55 g = 161 g

questions.q: You have 150 mL of solution with a concentration of 0.240 mol/L. How many moles of dissolved substance does it contain? Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You mix 125 mL of water (1.00 g/mL) with 45.0 mL of ethanol (0.790 g/mL). Calculate the mass percentage of water in the mixture. Round to 3 significant figures. Tip: this is a 3-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: mass of water = 125 g and mass of ethanol = 35.55 g. Step 2: total mass = 160.55 g. Step 3: 125 g : 160.55 g × 100% = 77.9%

questions.q: In the reaction 2 Mg + O<sub>2</sub> → 2 MgO, 3.20 g of O<sub>2</sub> reacts. The molar mass of O<sub>2</sub> is 32.0 g/mol and of MgO is 40.3 g/mol. How many grams of MgO are needed or formed? Round to 3 significant figures. Tip: this is a 3-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 3.20 g : 32.0 g/mol = 0.100 mol of O<sub>2</sub>. Step 2: mole ratio O<sub>2</sub> : MgO, so 0.200 mol of MgO. Step 3: 0.200 mol × 40.3 g/mol = 8.06 g

questions.q: You dilute 25.0 mL of a 2.00 mol/L solution with water to 250 mL. What is the concentration of the diluted solution in mol/L? Round to 2 significant figures. Tip: this is a 3-step problem. Only round the final answer.
